why: The student is right that the printed values are estimates, but the second half of the question asks whether the start page matters, and the answer says starting at page 3 would change the ranks. That is the StartPageMatters misconception, so the answer is L0 overall.

concepts.why: It correctly says that visit fractions from 100 moves only estimate the ranks, but gives no reason and does not apply this to the values.

concepts.quote: starting at page 3 would change the ranks
concepts.why: It holds the wrong rule that the ranks depend on the start page, but they converge to the same vector from any start.

concepts.quote: starting at page 3 would change the ranks
concepts.why: It contradicts the basic limit theorem, which says the random-surfer chain's long-run probabilities are the same whatever page it starts from.
